reference_sql:
WITH months AS (
  -- one row per month of the range
  SELECT DISTINCT month_start AS month
  FROM calendar
  WHERE cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
),
monthly AS (
  -- one row per month with webshop orders
  SELECT order_month AS month, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE store_code = 'WEB-01'
    AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY order_month
), filled AS (
  -- one row per month of the range
  SELECT m.month, COALESCE(s.revenue_eur, 0) AS revenue_eur
  FROM months m
  LEFT JOIN monthly s ON s.month = m.month
)
SELECT month, revenue_eur,
  revenue_eur - LAG(revenue_eur) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change_eur
FROM filled

solver.query: WITH months AS (SELECT CAST(m AS DATE) AS month FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2025-06-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS t(m)), r AS (SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', order_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur FROM sales WHERE store_code = 'WEB-01' AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-06-30' GROUP BY 1), g AS (SELECT m.month, COALESCE(r.revenue_eur, 0) AS revenue_eur FROM months m LEFT JOIN r ON r.month = m.month) SELECT month, revenue_eur, revenue_eur - LAG(revenue_eur) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change_eur FROM g
